text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The much-anticipated clash of queens has 
been won by Mejiro Dober! It's Mejiro 
Dober!!"
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "Ah... I... I did it...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I was completely lost in the moment... 
Honestly, I barely even remember how I 
ran, but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I won...! I've reached... my 
Senpai... my ideal—!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Pathetic. However... right now, I don't 
even have time to regret it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I must carve it into memory. And, I must 
move forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The glory of the "Empress"— How could I 
ever end things without reclaiming it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...My legs... have started... to 
tremble.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Overwhelmed by my senior's fierce aura—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Can I really say... that I reached my 
ideal? When I can barely even remember how 
I ran?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Say we ran it one more time—can you really 
say for certain that I wouldn't end up far 
behind again...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's no good—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No... No, if I stay like this, I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be like my seniors! Otherwise, 
there's no way I can ever become a new 
glory...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to... I have to do something...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let me run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

The instant she returned to the waiting 
room, Mejiro Dober said that to me with a 
look of pure desperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after her again really made me 
realize. The distance between me and Air 
Groove-senpai is still vast.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no time to mope around! 
This isn't like the Arima Kinen. I've 
decided to keep taking on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai will surely enter the 
spring Grand Prix next—the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for that too! I want to race 
Senpai there again and seize victory!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What do I lack... to become like Air 
Groove-senpai?!
—Not again.

Once again, that strange, familiar unease 
stirs within my chest.
And so, without thinking—
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?
Are you really sure that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What, what does that mean?

"...If I haven't even put it into words 
yet, there's no point in simply asking."

I resolved to think it over more and find 
an answer before talking to Mejiro 
Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...What a weird Trainer.

In any case, the next goal was set as the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
